items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: one day our Math teacher told the class... But the one important thing that Math does, it teaches you to think.

ctx.x: It's a discipline. Everything has to be disciplined. You have to be (?).

And one of the most important things I got out of Math is, one day our Math teacher told the class, he said, "Later on in life, you may never use all these intricate problems and whatnot. But the one important thing that Math does, it teaches you to think." And you know, thinking is one of the greatest things that we need to do. We all have that quality, and we need to use it. Because if you think it out, and it don't make sense, you don't use it! But if you use it and it makes sense, keep using it. And I know I…
So your suggestion is to study some form of Math, huh?
